label: MONEY TIP
hook: The ₹100 rule that finds ₹36,500 a year

slides.text: Pick one small daily spend you don't really need.
slides.sub: An extra snack, a delivery fee, a second chai

slides.text: Skip just ₹100 of it every day.
In one year, that adds up to ₹36,500.
Move it the same day with a quick UPI transfer to your savings account.
slides.sub: Out of sight, out of mind

slides.text: Try this today: choose your ₹100 and move it to savings tonight.
